parts.target: A **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit of yours that is not in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of any enemy unit.

data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), as it ends.

**Target:** A **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit of yours that is not in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of any enemy unit.

**Effect:** Pick an enemy unit up to 6" from the unit that has [Fallen Back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back) this turn. You can declare a charge with the unit, as though in [your Charge phase](vsdata:core-rule/charge-phase), but only that enemy unit can be the charge's target, and only if that enemy unit is eligible as a target. Even if the charge succeeds, the unit gets no Charge bonus this turn.
